name: Vercel Deploys
author: Poni
description: Your Vercel deployments beside the notch while they build, green or red when they finish, with branch, commit and build time for the recent ones.

settings.label: Vercel token
settings.help: Create one at vercel.com/account/tokens, scoped to just the account or team that owns these projects, with an expiry date. Saved in Poni's settings on this Mac and only sent to api.vercel.com.

settings.label: Team
settings.help: Optional. The team ID or slug from the team's settings page; leave empty for your personal account.

settings.label: Projects
settings.help: Optional. Comma-separated project names; leave empty to see every project.

id.name: Deploy Vercel
id.description: Deployment Vercel Anda di samping notch selama build, hijau atau merah saat selesai, lengkap dengan branch, commit, dan lama build untuk yang terbaru.

token.label: Token Vercel
token.help: Buat di vercel.com/account/tokens, dengan cakupan hanya akun atau tim pemilik proyek ini, dan beri tanggal kedaluwarsa. Disimpan di pengaturan Poni di Mac ini dan hanya dikirim ke api.vercel.com.

team.label: Tim
team.help: Opsional. ID atau slug tim dari halaman pengaturan tim; kosongkan untuk akun pribadi.

projects.label: Proyek
projects.help: Opsional. Nama proyek dipisah koma; kosongkan untuk melihat semua proyek.
